note: Re-audit pool for never-locked REDGE. EDGE SIDE CONVENTION (t46u): every edge is assigned to exactly one of LEDGE/REDGE by his majority 2025-26 alignment. LEDGE = defense's left edge (aligned over the offense's right tackle); REDGE = defense's right edge (over the offense's left tackle), matching the repo note 'Right-side edge (offense's left)'. Side evidence = nflverse weekly depth charts 2025 + 2026 (ESPN-sourced): each team-day snapshot counts once; LDE (4-3 or 3-4) or 3-4 WLB (ESPN 3-4 layout slot 4, left of LILB) = left; RDE or 3-4 SLB (slot 7, right of RILB) = right; 4-3 WLB/SLB are off-ball LBs and not counted. The side with more snapshots across both seasons wins; a player appears in only one list. PFF alignment splits (left/right snap counts) are paywalled and NGS publishes no side split, so depth charts are the side source; Madden 27's LEDG/REDG card label is reference only and does not decide side. Players from the shared LEDGE/REDGE pool whose majority side is the other side are excluded as OTHER_POSITION; side-screen contenders added. PROPOSED for commissioner approval. Composite is a triage order, not a rating.
